worked_solution:
Notice that we have a block diagonal matrix. Therefore, its determinant is equal to the product of the diagonal blocks' determinants:

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}v & 5{w}^{2} & 0 & 0 \\ 3v & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -8 & 5\end{aligned}| & =|\begin{aligned}v & 5{w}^{2} & 0 & 0 \\ 3v & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -8 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}v & 5{w}^{2} \\ 3v & 2\end{aligned}|\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & -1 \\ -8 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =\frac{1}{7}\cdot 7 \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
